title: Insert Linked Text Label (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Insert Linked Text Label applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Linked Text Label (BtnConnectedTextLabel) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Connected-text payload contract is pinned by new production Core tests
scenarios.expected:
The OneNote HTML marker contract builds '' with HTML-encoded text and line breaks as '
', tolerating null text; SourceMarker is the exact legacy substring; ReadLastModified parses the roundtrip-kind lastModifiedTime attribute and fails closed to DateTime.MinValue when absent or unparsable; the ConnectedTextTargetRecord DataContract keeps the legacy SourceId/Host/DocumentPath/TargetId JSON property names and round-trips.
